name: Provisional notification delivery
plain: Delivers notifications quietly without asking first, for the person to keep or turn off.
meaning: Inverts the prompt: app earns trust by showing value first. Android 13 prompts but defaults channels.

android.note: Apps targeting 33 and up must ask at runtime

ios.prompt_ui: Quiet delivery with keep or turn off buttons
ios.note: Delivered to Notification Center only; no sound or banner

limits.headline: Can send quiet notifications without asking first, which you can keep or turn off
limits.user_action: Nothing. Your first notification shows up quietly in Notification Center
can: Deliver alerts to Notification Center on iPhone with no sound or banner
Show you Keep and Turn off buttons on the first alert
Ask for full permission later on Android 13 or newer
cannot: Show a banner or play a sound until you choose Keep
Skip the prompt on Android 13 or newer; apps must ask at runtime
Stay if you tap Turn off
limits.reach_label: Quiet alerts only, until you choose
limits.differs: iPhone has quiet delivery with Keep and Turn off buttons. Android 13 and newer always asks.

story.what_it_is: Delivers alerts quietly to Notification Center without asking first, so you can choose to keep them.

marketing.name: Provisional authorization
marketing.pitch: Apple lets apps deliver alerts quietly at first so people can see their value before deciding.

story.for_you: You see a quiet alert in Notification Center with buttons to keep it or turn it off. There is no sound or pop up until you say keep.
story.for_makers: Makers get to show value before asking for the full permission. It can raise opt in rates, and it also lets an app send you something before you have decided.

use_cases.example: A news app tries a few quiet stories before you choose to keep alerts.
A store sends a quiet price drop to see if you care.
A new social app sends a few quiet updates to test interest.
A game sends a quiet daily reward note and asks you if you want more.
A task app tests a gentle daily reminder before a pop up.
A growth team measures how many people press Keep on a quiet alert.
A podcast app tests new episode alerts in the quiet tray first.

risks: Notification spam without a pop up
story.android_note: Android 13 always shows a prompt for apps that target it, so there is no quiet trial.
story.ios_note: Delivered to Notification Center only, with keep or turn off buttons.

technical_bounds: Content only shown in Notification Center on iOS
Not available as a no-permission path on Android 13+

history.change: Notification channels with importance levels added
